::: {#exr-bikeshare-negative}

#### Compare with linear regression

Consider a [linear regression](correlation-regression.qmd#def-linear-regression) of `bikers` on the same [covariates](model-validation.qmd#def-covariate) as the [Poisson regression model](poisson-regression.qmd#def-poisson-regression) of @exr-bikeshare-fit.
A count is never negative.

::: {.callout-tip}

#### Hint

`lm()` in R and `smf.ols()` in Python [fit](model-validation.qmd#def-fitted-model) the [linear regression](correlation-regression.qmd#def-linear-regression).
`fitted()` in R returns the [fitted values](prediction.qmd#def-fitted-value) of a model,
and the `fittedvalues` attribute of a `statsmodels` fit holds them in Python.

:::

For each of the two [fitted models](model-validation.qmd#def-fitted-model), count the hours with a negative [fitted value](prediction.qmd#def-fitted-value).

:::
